react-use useDebounce (debounced effect).description:
Debounce an effect, not a value: the callback runs once the dependencies stop changing. react-use has no debounced-value hook. Requires useDebounce from react-use.

防抖的是副作用而非值：依赖停止变化后回调才执行；react-use 没有防抖值的 Hook。需要从 react-use 导入 useDebounce。

react-use useThrottle (throttled value).description:
Throttle a changing value. Requires useThrottle from react-use.

节流一个变化中的值；需要从 react-use 导入 useThrottle。

react-use useThrottleFn (throttled resul.description:
Throttle a computation and read its latest result, which is null until the first call. Requires useThrottleFn from react-use.

节流一次计算并读取其最新结果，首次调用前为 null；需要从 react-use 导入 useThrottleFn。

react-use useToggle (boolean).description:
Manage a boolean with a toggle that also accepts an explicit next value. Requires useToggle from react-use.

管理布尔值，toggle 也可传入明确的下一个值；需要从 react-use 导入 useToggle。

react-use useLocalStorage.description:
Persist state to localStorage, with a remover. The value is undefined until the browser store is read. Requires useLocalStorage from react-use and a browser environment.

将状态持久化到 localStorage 并提供清除函数；读取到浏览器存储前值为 undefined。需要从 react-use 导入 useLocalStorage，并运行在浏览器环境。

react-use useClickAway.description:
Run a callback for clicks outside a ref. The ref comes first here, the reverse of the ahooks hook with the same name. Requires useClickAway from react-use and a target ref.

点击 ref 之外时执行回调；此处 ref 在前，与 ahooks 同名 Hook 的参数顺序相反。需要从 react-use 导入 useClickAway 和目标 ref。

react-use useEvent (DOM event).description:
Subscribe to a DOM event with automatic cleanup; the target defaults to window. Requires useEvent from react-use.

订阅 DOM 事件并自动清理，目标默认为 window；需要从 react-use 导入 useEvent。

react-use useCounter.description:
Manage a numeric counter with bounded actions. Requires useCounter from react-use.

管理数值计数器及其操作；需要从 react-use 导入 useCounter。

react-use useMedia (media query).description:
Track a CSS media query, with a default for the first server render. Requires useMedia from react-use.

跟踪 CSS 媒体查询，并为首次服务端渲染提供默认值；需要从 react-use 导入 useMedia。

react-use useCopyToClipboard.description:
Copy text to the clipboard and read the result of the last attempt. Requires useCopyToClipboard from react-use and a secure context.

复制文本到剪贴板并读取上次尝试的结果；需要从 react-use 导入 useCopyToClipboard，并运行在安全上下文中。

react-use useInterval.description:
Run a callback on an interval; pass null as the delay to pause it. Requires useInterval from react-use.

按间隔执行回调，delay 传 null 可暂停；需要从 react-use 导入 useInterval。
